shared_elements: dense field of small symbolic signs/glyphs
script-like signs organized in registers or panels
frontal/profile figure with elaborate headdress or headgear
carved relief on an upright slab/monument format
justification: Both surfaces combine human figures with a dense field of small pictographic signs on an upright monument, and in each case the signs occupy the greater part of the surface while the figures are set within or beside them. But A is dominated by a single large frontal standing figure whose body and headdress are fused with scrollwork and mask-like ornament covering the whole shaft, while B is a strictly ruled horizontal-line text with two small seated/kneeling profile figures confined to a lower panel — different figure scale, posture, orientation and organizational logic.
